hero.headline: Oħloq UGC ads for the world's best brands.
hero.body: Irreġistra to work with some of the world's biggest brands — signing up once means you could work with brands like Perplexity, Lovable, Bolt, Hims and more.
hero.footnote: Unsure if it's for you? Check out some of our case studies below.

guide.heading: Għadek m'intix ċert jekk hu tajjeb għalik?
guide.body: Ara l-gwida tagħna għall-kreaturi – gwida komprensiva dwar kif tiffilmja kontenut li jiġi approvat mill-ewwel darba, u kif taħdem mal-pjattaforma tagħna.

descriptions.verify_email_pending: Bgħatna link ta' verifika lil {email}. Iftaħha biex tlesti s-setup tal-kont tiegħek.
descriptions.forgot_password: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
descriptions.enable_2fa_intro: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the manual key. Then confirm by entering the six-digit code.
descriptions.auth_bootstrap_error: We could not load your account information. Check your connection and try again.
descriptions.recovery_codes_warning: Issejvja these one-time codes somewhere safe. They are your only way to sign in if you lose access to your authenticator.

native.wrong_door: L-app Catalyst hija għall-kreaturi. Jekk jogħġbok idħol fil-kont tiegħek fuq il-web fl-indirizz {correct_spa_url}.
